statement: Full Rosati-fixed real multiplication in characteristic p forces delta(A) to be a p-power; the Lie determinant condition gives delta=1 and is automatic for totally ramified p
depends_on: Yu2003 Lemma2.7 and Proposition2.8; C.4j; C.4n; C.4p
notes: Actual Jacobian-product retractions for surfaces in p!=2 and threefolds in p>=5; all p under the Lie condition, with no ordinary or supersingular assumption. This does not close generic End=Z type(1,2) surfaces or arbitrary supersingular threefolds in p2/3.
